name: Scribe
author: Benjamin Werner
description: Mark text anywhere, press a key, and a corrected version lands in your clipboard. Scribe reads the primary selection, sends it to an LLM with a prompt that fixes spelling, grammar and punctuation while preserving the original language, tone and formatting, then copies the result back and notifies you. A bar icon shows the request in flight; clicking it opens a panel with the history of past corrections and the settings. The LLM is reached through a small adapter contract -- an Anthropic adapter, a `claude` CLI adapter that needs no API key, and an OpenAI-compatible adapter that also covers ollama ship with the plugin, and any executable honouring the documented stdin/stdout shape can replace them.

barWidget.description: Corrects the marked text with an LLM and puts it on the clipboard.

schema.label: Backend
schema.description: Name of an executable in ~/.config/omarchy/scribe/backends/ or the plugin's backends/ directory.

schema.label: Model
schema.description: Passed through to the backend verbatim.

schema.label: Endpoint
schema.description: Only for the openai backend: the OpenAI-compatible base URL, e.g. http://gpu-box.local:11434/v1 for a remote ollama. Empty uses the backend's own default.

schema.label: Effort
schema.description: How hard the model should deliberate. Empty lets the backend decide. anthropic: low/medium/high/xhigh/max. openai/ollama: sent as reasoning_effort -- 'none' switches a thinking model's reasoning off, which for proofreading is about six times faster at the same quality.

schema.label: Fall back to the clipboard
schema.description: When nothing is selected, correct whatever is on the regular clipboard instead.

schema.label: Keep a history
schema.description: Off writes nothing to disk at all.

schema.label: Store the text in history
schema.description: Off keeps only timestamps, model and length -- no corrected text on disk.
